name: Bokura no Chotto Kowai Yoru
original_name: 僕らのちょっと怖い夜
source:
Fifth-year elementary school student Nao comes to an abandoned hospital with two of his friends as a test of courage.
They say it had been abandoned after a nurse caused the death of multiple patients due to a grave error in her treatments...
Fully aware of the weight of her actions, she killed herself by jumping off the roof, but unable to move on, her spirit is said to still be roaming the vicinity.
Just how scared is Nao going to get while wandering the halls of this hospital...?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14057]Freem![/url]]
translation:
小学五年级学生直与两位朋友一起来到一所废弃医院试胆。
据说，一名护士在治疗中犯下严重错误，导致多名患者死亡，医院因此废弃……
那名护士深感自责，从楼顶跳下自尽，却始终未能安息，她的灵魂至今仍在医院附近徘徊。
在这所医院的走廊里四处探索时，直究竟会遇上多么可怕的事情……？！
